A resolution policy

Source: R/policy.R
quorum_policy.Rd

Declares how a comparison is resolved into one carried answer: the fallback priority of the lenses, how many must contribute before a verdict is issued, the agreement thresholds to compare them with, the evidential weight below which a pair is not counted, and what a cell falls back to when no lens stands behind a number.

Usage

quorum_policy(
  order,
  min_lenses = 2L,
  thresholds = NULL,
  independence_min = 0,
  status_quo = NULL,
  safe_action = NULL
)

Arguments

order

Character vector of lens names in fallback priority: the first name that is present, grounded and decisive is the one carried.

min_lenses

Single whole number: how many lenses must contribute before a comparison is a quorum at all.

thresholds

A list of agreement thresholds, or NULL to read agreement_thresholds() at the point of use.

independence_min

Single number: the evidential weight at or above which a pair counts towards concordance.

status_quo

A single number to fall back on, or NULL to abstain instead of defaulting.

safe_action

The action a single lens falls back to inside its own decision. It is carried for the caller and is what policy_committed(fixed = "zero") resolves an abstention to; the cascade never mints a rate from it.

Value

A quorum_policy S7 object.

Details

status_quo is the whole of the difference between a cell that defaults and a cell that abstains. Left NULL, a resolution with no decisive lens abstains and issues no number at all; set to a value, that value is carried and the cell is marked as having defaulted rather than decided.

thresholds left NULL means the agreement thresholds in force at the time of use, read from agreement_thresholds() when the metric layer is present, so a policy written today does not pin yesterday's cut-offs.

See also

quorum_resolve(), policy_committed().

Examples

quorum_policy(order = c("mechanism", "statistical"), status_quo = 60)
#> <quorum::quorum_policy>
#>  @ order           : chr [1:2] "mechanism" "statistical"
#>  @ min_lenses      : int 2
#>  @ thresholds      : NULL
#>  @ independence_min: num 0
#>  @ status_quo      : num 60
#>  @ safe_action     : NULL
